hazards.description: The wide roadway at the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The straight, wide roadway lacks physical measures to slow vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Long, straight roadway
hazards.description: The wide, straight road design without visible traffic calming measures may encourage vehicle speeding.

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a large institutional building, there is no marked crossing visible, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway in front of the building.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Add zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to crossing locations.

interventions.title: Vertical traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Street Furniture/Planters
interventions.description: Installing a buffer zone with planters or street furniture would provide better separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight residential/institutional stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds in this high-density residential context.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming such as speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain appropriate for a residential and park-adjacent context.

interventions.title: Buffer Zone with Planting
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the walkway to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Adding street trees would provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the street, improving the pedestrian experience and naturally calming traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility marked crosswalks accompanied by pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential and institutional zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Add speed cushions or humps to slow vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential/institutional block.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk would provide shade, improve aesthetics, and act as a psychological traffic calming measure.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers like bollards or planters to separate the bike lane from motor vehicle traffic, enhancing safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide shade, improve the aesthetic quality of the walk, and create a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Installing street trees or planters would provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improve aesthetics, and provide shade.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant it, a marked midblock crossing with curb extensions would reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees, particularly on the right side, to provide a physical buffer and slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a vertical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking or Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Designating space for parking or a protected bike lane would provide a buffer for pedestrians and narrow the perceived travel lane for cars.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian-activated signal, to provide a safe crossing point for the institutional building.
